title: Why Verification Is a Critical Bridge Against Fraud, but Not a Silver Bullet
summary: Taking time out of EBAday 2026, Jonathan Cardwell, Business Development Lead at Banfico, joined FinextraTV to discuss the necessary strategies to make fraud verification a success. Cardwell began by explaining where Verification works particularly well, but also where it struggles to properly combat fraud to the nature of authorise push payment fraud - namely, that it's authorised by a verified person. He described the need to add friction into the process on a risk-based approach, to avoid too much disruption to customer experience. He describes verification, not as a silver bullet but as a critical bridge between fraud prevention and fraud detection.

title: How to Provide Optionality and Transparency for the Modern Customer
summary:
Joining the EBAday FinextraTV studio, Philip Konopik, SVP, Head of Commercial and Money Movement Solutions, Visa Europe, provided insights into the need for speed and flexibility for the modern customer. Konopik explained how building infrastructure is about creating optionality and 'stitching together network to network' in order to provide the best solutions for clients. Konopik described transparency as the most critical point within money movement, categorising it as foundational rather than hygienic.
